title: The Backwards Brain Bicycle - Smarter Every Day 133
summary: Destin of Smarter Every Day learns to ride a bicycle whose steering is reversed, taking about eight months, and compares it with how his young son learned much faster. It illustrates knowledge versus understanding and brain plasticity in adults versus children.
why: HN cites it widely in discussions of tacit knowledge, habit, unlearning and adult versus child learning.

quote.text: There is an absolutely fascinating video about plasticity of learning between adults and children that I'd highly recommend watching [1].
